proposal_topic_intro:
This proposal explores the convergence of advanced sensing modalities with AI-driven patient monitoring. Terahertz imaging offers unprecedented depth resolution in tissue and material characterisation; when combined with cloud-based clinical decision support, these capabilities can lower barriers to specialist diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

The AIoT paradigm for smart-home elder care demonstrates that continuous sensor fusion can reliably infer activity states and detect anomalies in real time. Integrating such monitoring pipelines with medical-imaging backends---sharing processing infrastructure and privacy-preserving access controls---represents a natural next step.

participating_pis.research_summary: Alpha leads Lab-Alpha, a group combining applied photonics, medical imaging, and algebraic geometry. Recent work spans frequency-modulated continuous-wave terahertz systems for aerospace nondestructive testing, a privacy-preserving cloud framework for clinical image analysis, and morphism dimensions in 3-Calabi-Yau categories.

Beta leads Lab-Beta, focused on AI-driven eldercare and causal machine learning. The lab built an AIoT system achieving >99% activity-inference accuracy for dementia monitoring in smart homes, and developed a causal variable discovery framework for multi-label data with minimal-redundancy feature selection.

Gamma leads Lab-Gamma, specialising in spiking neural networks and LLM-guided algorithm selection. The lab produced a biologically inspired SNN model for precise sound localisation in noisy environments, a multi-task speaker-verification framework, and pioneered LLM-evolutionary algorithm selection.
